games.title: Escape From Vlogger Runaway
games.description:
Escape from the Vlogger is an atmospheric survival horror game with stealth elements, adventure action, and quest-based puzzles.

The main character breaks into the house of a popular vlogger to uncover his secrets. But instead of the truth, a trap is waiting behind the door. One goal: escape alive.

Explore dark rooms, search for items, break locks, and solve logical puzzles. Each room is a separate quest puzzle with hiding places, secret passages, and traps.

Hide from the vlogger. He hears every sound and patrols the house. Stealth is the key survival mechanic. Move quietly, predict his routes, and use the environment.

Calm exploration can suddenly turn into a chase. Humor and satire create a unique atmosphere, tense and funny at the same time.

Horror, stealth, puzzles, escape, and survival. All of this is Escape from the Vlogger!

Tips
Stuck? Get a hint by watching an ad.
In the pause menu, you can adjust sensitivity, music, and sound.
Each session is unique. Progress is not saved after exiting.
Last Updated
Jul 22, 2026

Controls
Desktop

WASD = movement
Mouse = camera rotation
LMB = interact
C = crouch
P = pause
I = hint
Mobile

Left joystick = movement
Swipe on the screen = camera rotation
On-screen buttons = interact, crouch, pause, hint
